welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to Everbrook Academy in Arlington, VA! We are an educational preschool and learning center located in the Crystal City neighborhood. Here at Everbrook Academy, we provide exciting, hands-on learning opportunities for children ages six weeks through 5 years. Our curriculum follows a STEAM-based philosophy where Science, Technology, Engineering, the Arts and Math are integrated into daily lessons. All teachers have degrees in either early education or a child-related field and are passionate about educating young learners. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. I invite you to schedule a tour to visit Everbrook Academy here in Crystal City to learn how our school will prepare your child for elementary school and beyond.
